name: file-preview
title: File Preview
description: A file in a chat answer, previewed on the chat card: its type icon, name and size or pages with Download and Open; Markdown rendered with its formatting (the first dozen lines, fading out), a CSV's first five rows, a PDF's first page, an image; a click opens the viewer, and a failed preview says why with Retry.

meta.whenToUse: A file an agent made or a person attached, shown in the chat where it appeared.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list of a record's files (FileCard), a file named inside running text (InlineChip's file chip), or a file being uploaded (UploadCard).
